description: Confirmatory survey-weighted tests (2023-2024) of patterns suggested by boosting
population: CRSS police-reported crashes (all severities, national probability sample) with a determinable maximum severity (fatal: MAXSEV_IM 9 excluded; ka: MAXSEV_IM 5 and 9 excluded, so ka rows are a subset); train 2016-2021, validation 2022, test 2023-2024
method: SurveyLogit (Taylor linearisation, PSUSTRAT/PSU_VAR, design df) with all circumstance-stage covariates + vehicle-age bands; product term or non-linearity terms; Holm across candidates; fatal metrics use every crash with a known fatal outcome; ka metrics use only the crashes where ka is known (MAXSEV_IM 5 and 9 excluded), so the two outcomes differ in n
